description: Conservative distant woodland belts visually traced from a bounded Spring2026 county ortho. Context only; not campus property or individual tree locations.

source.source_date: Spring2026; exact flight date not exposed
source.rights: Image cached as an attributed research reference only. Public availability does not establish a redistribution or texture license; do not paint this image into the scene.

trace_method: Manual conservative outline of visible woody cover in a 2048x1144 inspection view of the 2550x1425 georeferenced ortho. Polygons approximate the interior of woodland and exclude obvious clearings; no automatic vegetation classification or surveyed boundary is claimed.
interpretation_rules: Instantiate only within polygons, preferably inset8m; do not fill outside them.
Keep immediate pond/open marsh and all y<405m under the existing detailed evidence. These belts do not replace that geometry.
Large marsh areas and a lake separate the traced belts. A continuous distant forest wall would contradict the source.
Ground elevations are separate point-query evidence where available; canopy heights, species and crowns remain inferred.
Use low-detail irregular silhouettes only for distant context. This is neither a current tree inventory nor a property ownership delineation.

polygons.label: Northwest woodland south of curved road
polygons.canopy_height_basis: Inferred mature woodland presentation range; no lidar height measurement beyond y405m.
polygons.density_note: Discontinuous crowns within the traced belt; retain gaps, do not turn it into a solid wall.

ground_elevation.provider: USGS Elevation Point Query Service / 3DEP dynamic elevation service
ground_elevation.vertical_datum: Interpreted as NAVD88 from USGS CONUS 3DEP convention; datum/geoid is not stated in this individual EPQS response.
ground_elevation.confidence: medium for the sampled point; low for applying one point uniformly across an entire belt
ground_elevation.limitations: An interpolated DEM point, not a surveyed elevation. Source acquisition-date attribute is preserved verbatim and is not equated to a lidar flight date. Resolution is not vertical accuracy. Terrain variation within the polygon is not sampled.

elevation_source_notes.interpretation: USGS describes EPQS as interpolated elevations from multiple-resolution 3DEP DEMs. Typical CONUS vertical datum is NAVD88. Exact local source accuracy and geoid realization are not established by these five queries.

revisions_after_overlay_inspection: Trimmed wood-01 northern lawn/road margin and western residential edge.
Trimmed wood-02 to the southern woody interior, excluding visible residential structures and their clearings.
Marked wood-05 ineligible because its coarse outline still mixes residential structures and lawns.
checks: All coordinates finite; all polygons strictly north of y405m; each representative query point lies inside its candidate polygon.
Five bounded EPQS point responses returned plausible1m-resolution DEM elevations; raw values and source attributes preserved.
No additional lidar tile downloaded; no source imagery used as a scene texture.
validation.scope: Research geometry only. No scene integration, terrain interpolation, rendered silhouette or camera-view validation is implied.
